name: Tantei Jinguuji Saburou: Mikan no Report
original_name: 探偵 神宮寺三郎 未完のルポ
source:
An overseas package containing a small key arrives at the detective agency from Jingūji's journalist acquaintance. Jingūji must uncover the hidden meaning of the key.

[From [url=http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Tantei_Jing%C5%ABji_Sabur%C5%8D]Wikipedia[/url]]
translation:
神宫寺的一名记者熟人从海外寄来包裹，里面装着一把小钥匙。神宫寺必须查明这把钥匙背后隐藏的含义。

[摘自[url=http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Tantei_Jing%C5%ABji_Sabur%C5%8D]Wikipedia[/url]]
